description:
You are a graduate student who accidentally deleted 5 critical papers while cleaning up your library. Your task is to restore these specific papers from the Trash and organize them into your 'Thesis References' collection.

1. Go to the 'Trash' in the left sidebar.
2. Find and restore these 5 papers:
   - 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon, 1948)
   - 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (Turing, 1950)
   - 'A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs' (Dijkstra, 1959)
   - 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al., 2017)
   - 'Generative Adversarial Nets' (Goodfellow et al., 2014)
   (To restore: Select items, Right-click > Restore to Library)

3. After restoring, add ALL 5 of these papers to the existing 'Thesis References' collection.

Do NOT remove the papers already in 'Thesis References'.

trashed_titles: A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs
existing_titles: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
